# Dockerfile for lammps-reax on AWS CPU
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a modern, stable environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies for building LAMMPS
# - build-essential, cmake, git: For compiling the source code
# - python3: (FIX) Required by the modern LAMMPS build system
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: For MPI support, crucial for HPC
# - libfftw3-dev: FFTW library, a common dependency for LAMMPS KSPACE package
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone)
# - libgomp1: For OpenMP support, as requested
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    python3 \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libfftw3-dev \
    ca-certificates \
    libgomp1 && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the latest version of the LAMMPS source code
RUN git clone https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /tmp/lammps-src

# Configure, build, and install LAMMPS
# We create a build directory as is standard practice with CMake
# -D BUILD_MPI=on: Enable MPI support
# -D PKG_KSPACE=on: Enable the KSPACE package for FFT-based long-range electrostatics
# -D PKG_REAXFF=on: Enable the ReaxFF package, the core requirement
# The executable 'lmp' is then copied to a location on the system PATH
RUN mkdir /tmp/lammps-src/build && \
    cd /tmp/lammps-src/build && \
    cmake \
        -D BUILD_MPI=on \
        -D PKG_KSPACE=on \
        -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
        ../cmake && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    cp /tmp/lammps-src/build/lmp /usr/local/bin/

# Set the working directory for running simulations
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the specific ReaxFF example files into the working directory
RUN cp -r /tmp/lammps-src/examples/reaxff/HNS/* .

# Clean up the build directory to reduce image size
RUN rm -rf /tmp/lammps-src

# The container is now ready. The command to run simulations will be provided
# at runtime, typically via a Kubernetes Job specification.
# Example: mpirun -np 4 lmp -in in.hns

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
# MiniCluster manifest for a LAMMPS ReaxFF experiment on AWS CPU instances.
# This configuration defines a single-pod MiniCluster to run the specified LAMMPS command.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deployment namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks for the Flux job. The operator will execute `flux run -n 1 ...`
  tasks: 1

  # Defines the main application container. There should only be one for this use case.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to execute. The Flux Operator will wrap this with `flux run`.
      # This command runs a LAMMPS simulation using the ReaxFF potential.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # launcher is false, meaning this container is a worker pod, not a dedicated launcher.
      launcher: false
      # runFlux must be true for the application container to participate in the Flux instance.
      runFlux: true

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforces strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

  # Pod cleanup policy. false preserves the pod for inspection after completion.
  cleanup: false

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 4 -v y 4 -v z 4 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
    runFlux: true
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

manager.name: Build and Deploy LAMMPS
manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.details: Ensure all globbed files from examples/reaxff/HNS from the root of the lammps codebase are in the WORKDIR. Clone the latest branch of LAMMPS. You MUST put lmp on the PATH. You MUST install libgomp1.

context.optimize:
Run in.reaxff.hns in the pwd with lmp -v x 8 -v y 8 -v z 8 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite      
You MUST minimize the lammps wall time.
